title: KNBS county crop production (Area + Production), Kenya
source: KNBS National Agriculture Production Report — 2023-2024 edition (years 2019-2023) + 2024-2025 edition (year 2024, provisional)
citation: KNBS 2024. National Agriculture Production Report: 2023-2024. Nairobi, Kenya.
license: KNBS — public official statistics; cite KNBS.
method: Dual-engine deterministic extraction (_sources/parse_napr.py) per METHODOLOGY_extraction_QA.md. Two independent position/character engines — pdfplumber extract_tables + PyMuPDF get_text word-clustering — extract each county annex; values parsed by explicit code (comma-strip), never read by an LLM. A crop is served only if the two engines AGREE cell-by-cell AND the county sum reconciles to the annex's printed national Total (additivity).
validation: 12 crops. Food crops (10) additivity 100% every year. Maize + coffee + cotton annexes are landscape tables rotated 90 on the page: de-rotated by word x-position. Maize cross-checks the clean Top-20 table exactly (190/190) + additivity 100%. Coffee: 20 itemised counties = ~87% of the printed national total (rest unlisted); crop-year mapped to ending calendar year. Cotton: 18 growing counties, area/tonnes/value.
grain: one row per crop × county × year

columns.crop: crop (Sorghum, Finger millet, Pearl millet, Dry beans, Cowpeas, Green grams, Pigeon peas, Irish potato, Sweet potato)
columns.pdf_page: annex page (a human can open it)
columns.dual_ok: passed the dual-engine agreement + additivity gates

coverage: 12 crops. Food crops (8) span 2019-2024 (2024 provisional from the 2025 edition, de-rotated); coffee (20 counties ~87%) & cotton (18 counties, +value) span 2019-2023; livestock 2021. Cross-edition overlap 2020-2023 identical except a systematic sweet-potato revision (2022 ~+18%, 2023 ~+2%) + 1 maize county - see _sources/edition_diffs_2024ed_vs_2025ed.csv.
known_gaps: 2024 only for the 8 food crops (from the 2025 edition food annexes). Millet is combined in 2025 (vs finger+pearl in 2024) so no 2024 millet appended; cassava is new in 2025 (not added). Coffee/cotton 2024 not appended (industrial annexes not yet pulled).
2019-2023 use the 2024 edition; a KNBS sweet-potato revision means the 2023->2024 seam carries a basis change for sweet potato.
Livestock 2022-23 (one page failed dual-engine); poultry annexes.
used_by: notebook.qmd Key Facts — 'What does my county produce?' (Table / Bars / Treemap / Lineplot views)
